learning_objective: 🎯 You will learn how to use grammar 'glue' to connect words, phrases, and short sentences together to make longer, smoother sentences!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Conjunctions are joining words! They act like super-strong glue that sticks words, groups of words, or short sentences together so you do not have to write choppy, robotic sentences.
We use 'and' to join similar ideas or add information, like 'I love apples AND bananas'. We use 'but' to show a contrast or a different idea, like 'I love apples, BUT I dislike bananas.'
When you have to make a choice or show different options, you use 'or'. For example, 'Do you want tea OR coffee?' It tells the listener they can pick one!
When you want to explain WHY something happened, use the conjunction 'because'. It links an action to its reason, like 'I am wearing a jacket BECAUSE it is very cold.'

fun_activity.title: ✍️ The Sentence Builder Puzzle
fun_activity.instructions: Write two short, boring sentences like 'It was raining. I went out.' Now, be a grammar wizard and combine them into one awesome sentence using the word BUT or ALTHOUGH!

quick_recap: ⭐ Conjunctions are words that join other words, phrases, or sentences.
⭐ 'But' shows a difference or contrast between ideas.
⭐ 'Or' gives choices, and 'Because' gives a reason for an action.
